source.title: 金鐘58／同台吳宗憲、胡瓜角逐主持人獎　沈玉琳：此生無憾
source.description:
Zhang Yao-ren’s Golden Bell Portrait

Zhang Yao-ren appears in a studio portrait, dressed in a black fuzzy cardigan layered over a brown shirt and white undershirt. His dark hair is tousled, and he gazes directly at the camera with a composed expression, one hand gently touching his neck. The neutral gray background and soft lighting create a calm, focused atmosphere.

This photograph illustrates Zhang Yao-ren’s first nomination at the 58th Golden Bell Awards, as reported by StyleTC. After seven years in entertainment, he competes for the reality and documentary program host award for “大港ê台灣.” Quotes from fellow nominees Shen Yulin and Melody
